protocol.threshold_source: Unchanged protocol-v4 min_pad_normal_n; event label, not a new success threshold.
protocol.origin_epoch: qpos/qvel before solve i; latest available solved contact is i-1. Forecast target state and solved contact at i+h.
protocol.contact_predictor: Persist the last completed pair-load label for both baselines.
protocol.aggregation: Each whole episode separately; overlapping windows are correlated diagnostics, not independent trials or held-out validation. No training partition.
protocol.scope: Offline descriptive analysis of existing synthetic data. No causal response, policy improvement, hardware validation, training or new physics.

original_qualification.scope: Synthetic fixed-wrist native contact qualification. Task failure alone is not solver failure or hardware validation.

episodes.contact_scope: Pad-normal pair loads, not net force. Missing geometric contact distance is unobserved.
